# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2022 -- Public-Private Partnership Code

**Resolution No. 04, Series of 2022**

## Summary

Comprehensive Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Code establishing the framework for PPP projects in [[Pitogo]]. Recognizes the role of the private sector in infrastructure, development, and social service-related projects. Creates the Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) framework per the [[1987 Philippine Constitution]] Section 20, Article II. The ordinance spans 33 pages of detailed provisions covering PPP modalities, procurement procedures, and project implementation guidelines.

## Key Provisions

- Establishes the legal framework for Public-Private Partnership projects in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- Defines eligible PPP project types including infrastructure, development, and social service-related projects
- Creates institutional mechanisms for PPP project identification, evaluation, and approval
- Sets procurement procedures for PPP projects
- Establishes financing framework for infrastructure per [[Sec-302-RA7160]]
- Defines roles and responsibilities of both public and private sector participants
- Provides for monitoring and evaluation of PPP project implementation
